title: Payroll ranking of departments
statementMd:
Rank departments by total salary, highest first. Show the department name and total.

Expected columns: `department`, `payroll`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Sum salaries per department and sort by the sum.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name AS department, SUM(e.salary) AS payroll FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY payroll DESC;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
